metadata.title: Codeflow-Compatible Integration Test Execution and Error Resolution Workflow
metadata.purpose: Execute tests specifically in the tests/integration directory to detect and resolve errors while maintaining complete project integrity. Implement error detection, classification, prioritization, and resolution following codeflow's established patterns and architecture. Ensure all fixes align with PRD requirements and respect the architectural boundaries defined in .project_meta. Apply pattern-based solutions that maintain consistency with existing code patterns and architecture. Ensure seamless integration with the broader codebase through comprehensive verification against project metadata. Actively utilize pattern learning to discover, analyze, and catalog patterns from integration tests to enhance the pattern knowledge base. Automatically apply learned patterns to new implementations and existing code through pattern-based code generation and refactoring.

target_workflow_steps.step_emphasis: Verify project structure integrity and PRD alignment before test execution.
Ensure test execution context aligns with previous development discussions.
Validate PRD requirements specific to integration functionality before executing tests.
Review architecture specifications in .project_meta/.architecture to guide test fixes.
Ensure fixes respect module boundaries defined in .project_meta/.architecture/module_definitions.json.
Cross-reference test failures with stories in roadmap to ensure fixes align with development plans.
Apply fixes as defined story tasks, ensuring pattern application and architecture compliance with real-time pattern learning and detection.
Validate fixes with comprehensive integration testing that preserves system integrity.
Apply codeflow's sophisticated error handling for any failures during testing or fixes.

Actively analyze and identify patterns from integration tests and fixes, applying pattern_learner and pattern_analyzer to categorize, validate and enhance the pattern catalog in .project_meta/.patterns with comprehensive pattern metrics, evolution tracking, and relationship mapping.
Automatically apply validated patterns to code through pattern-based code generation, transformations, and intelligent refactoring using pattern templates and context awareness.
target_workflow_steps.step_configuration: Trigger review after every 3 fixed integration test errors or iteration completion, with enhanced focus on integration-specific pattern emergence.
Ensure architectural integrity after significant test fixes.
Execute pattern application cycle after pattern catalog updates, applying learned patterns to applicable code with automated verification.

quality_standards.standard: All fixes must adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) as defined in .project_meta/.architecture/architecture_principles.md.

Implementations must follow patterns documented in .project_meta/.patterns/pattern_catalog.json and avoid anti-patterns.
Code changes must not increase coupling metrics beyond thresholds defined in .project_meta/.architecture/architecture_metrics/coupling_metrics.json.
Fixes must preserve or improve cohesion metrics documented in .project_meta/.architecture/architecture_metrics/cohesion_metrics.json.
All changes must be verified against quality attribute requirements in relevant .project_meta/.architecture/architecture_metrics/ files.
Test fixes must not introduce new dependency conflicts as tracked in .project_meta/.dependencies/conflict_log.json.
Root cause analysis must trace to architectural components and patterns to identify systemic issues.
Documentation updates must maintain freshness metrics tracked in .project_meta/.docs/metrics/doc_freshness_index.json.
Error resolution must improve effectiveness metrics as measured in .project_meta/.errors/metrics/effectiveness_score.json.
Changes must ensure integration stability as measured in .project_meta/.integration/metrics/stability_index.json is maintained or improved.
New implementations must be actively scanned by pattern_learner to detect emerging patterns and anti-patterns.
Pattern implementation correctness must be verified with pattern_analyzer to ensure pattern consistency score above 90%.
Integration test-specific patterns must be documented with comprehensive examples and context information.
Pattern relationships must be continuously updated in .project_meta/.patterns/relationships/pattern_dependencies.json to track pattern interactions.
Pattern templates must be comprehensive with clear context information, implementation examples, and variability points.
Applied patterns must be traceable to their pattern template source with implementation parameters.
Pattern applications must achieve a minimum quality score of 85% as measured by pattern_analyzer.
Automated pattern applications must pass all architectural validation and integration tests.

processing_instructions.step: 1. Initialize workflow by verifying project structure, PRD, and architecture documentation integrity.
2. Load context from chats and previous development history to understand the integration module's purpose and requirements.
3. Analyze the integration module's architectural position using module_definitions.json and dependency_graph.json.
4. Execute tests in tests/integration directory while monitoring for architectural conformance and pattern adherence, with active pattern_learner running to identify patterns.
5. For each failing test, perform comprehensive error analysis using error_analyzer approach to determine root causes, while utilizing pattern_analyzer to detect pattern-related issues.
6. Classify errors based on architectural impact, pattern violations, and integration issues using standardized taxonomies, with pattern categorization.
7. Develop fixes that maintain architectural integrity, follow established patterns, and preserve module boundaries, while actively applying pattern_learner for implementation guidance.
8. Validate fixes through multi-level testing including unit, integration, and architecture conformance validation, with pattern_analyzer verification.
9. Update all relevant metadata files in .project_meta to reflect changes, fixes, and learnings, including pattern catalog and metrics.
10. Apply newly learned and validated patterns to existing codebases using pattern templates and transformation rules.
11. Validate pattern applications using automated verification and quality metrics, ensuring architectural integrity.
12. Conduct periodic reviews to assess architectural integrity, pattern consistency, and documentation currency, with focused pattern effectiveness analysis.
processing_instructions.error_handling: Apply the comprehensive error handling framework defined in codeflow, with error logging, classification, recovery orchestration, and transaction-based integrity preservation, enhanced with pattern learning for error resolution strategies.
